problem:

Question 4
?

Paul is buying a cell phone at an online store. The price of the cell phone is P dollars, and Paul also has to pay $15 for the shipping and handling of the product.

What expression represents the total cost, in dollars, of the cell phone?

a
15P
b
15P+P
c
15(P+1)
d
P+15
e
P+15P
